title: ABSENTIA: Detecting Broken Access Control Vulnerabilities in Web Applications
title_zh: ABSENTIA：检测 Web 应用中的失效访问控制漏洞

paragraphs.en: Broken access control, the failure of authorization, is one of the most prevalent web security risks. Unlike injection, a flow of untrusted input into a dangerous operation, authorization is a relation: who may act on what, not how data moves. Each application decides that relation for itself, so no rule written in advance carries to the next. An LLM agent can infer it from the code, but with no systematic way to cover the application and prioritize what to inspect, its search stays undirected and access-control flaws go undetected.
paragraphs.zh: 访问控制漏洞，即授权失败，是最常见的网络安全风险之一。 与注入攻击（未经信任的输入流入危险操作）不同，授权是一种关系：谁可以执行什么操作，而非数据如何流动。 每个应用都需要自行定义这种关系，因此预先制定的规则无法直接适用于下一个应用。 LLM 智能体可以从代码中推断出这种关系，但如果没有系统化的方法来覆盖整个应用并确定检查的优先级，其搜索过程将缺乏方向性，访问控制漏洞也将无法被检测到。

paragraphs.en: We present Absentia , a security scaffolding that turns general LLM agents into systematic vulnerability detectors for the backend of web applications, run as an audit by the developers and security engineers who maintain the code. Under its direction, the agents build a graph that maps the application’s routes to the code behind them. Absentia then works route by route, applying invariant falsification: it infers the properties the code is meant to satisfy, and where one is not enforced, reports the route for maintainer review.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Absentia，这是一种安全框架，可将通用 LLM 智能体转变为用于检测网络应用后端系统漏洞的工具，由负责维护代码的开发人员和安全工程师以审计形式运行。 在其指导下，这些智能体会构建一个图，将应用程序的路径与其对应的代码关联起来。 随后，Absentia 会逐条路径进行工作，并应用不变量反证法：它推断出代码应满足的属性，并在属性未被强制执行时，报告该路径以供维护人员审查。

paragraphs.en: We also release BAC-Bench , a benchmark of 30 broken access control advisories across 25 repositories, 3 languages, and 9 frameworks, each published in 2025 or later, verified by a human auditor, and paired with its fixing commit, so credit requires flagging the vulnerable version and not the fixed one. Absentia recalls 19 of them, 17 under paired credit, and an LLM verifier confirms 51% of its findings. CodeQL and Semgrep recall none, and an unstructured agent on the same model recalls 3. In the OWASP Benchmark injection categories, Absentia leads the dedicated analyzers in Python and trails only CodeQL and IRIS in Java.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还发布了 BAC-Bench，这是一个基准测试，包含来自 25 个仓库、3 种语言和 9 个框架的 30 条访问控制漏洞建议。这些建议均发布于 2025 年或之后，经过人工审计员验证，并附有对应的修复提交记录，因此获得认可时需要指出存在漏洞的版本，而非已修复的版本。 Absentia 识别出其中 19 条，17 条属于配对认可范畴，且 LLM 验证器确认了其发现结果的 51%。 CodeQL 和 Semgrep 均未识别出任何一条，而基于同一模型的非结构化智能体则识别出了 3 条。 在 OWASP 基准测试的注入类别中，Absentia 在 Python 专用分析器中表现领先，而在 Java 中仅落后于 CodeQL 和 IRIS。

paragraphs.en: OpenReview is a platform on which many machine-learning conferences run peer review. In November 2025, during ICLR 2026’s review cycle, a broken access control flaw in its API exposed the identities of authors, reviewers, and area chairs for more than 10,000 submissions [ 18 ] . Parties who obtained the data then harassed, intimidated, and offered bribes to reviewers, and the organizers could no longer establish which reviews had already been influenced. Scores were restored to their pre-breach state and the area chair of every submission was reassigned, but the anonymity that the process depends on could not be recovered.
paragraphs.zh: OpenReview 是一个许多机器学习会议用于开展同行评审的平台。 2025 年 11 月，在 ICLR 2026 的评审周期中，其 API 存在的一个访问控制漏洞暴露了超过 10,000 份投稿的作者、评审员和领域主席的身份 [ 18 ]。 获取数据的相关方随后对评审员进行骚扰、威胁和贿赂，组织方已无法确定哪些评审已经受到影响。 评分被恢复至漏洞发生前的状态，每份投稿的领域主席也被重新分配，但该流程所依赖的匿名性已无法恢复。

paragraphs.en: A comparison with SQL injection shows what makes broken access control hard to detect in source code (Figure ). In an injection the defect is a flow, in which a request parameter reaches the database query in a form that lets it alter the statement. The property violated is the same in every application, so static application security testing (SAST) tools trace these flows with rules written once for a language. Broken access control has no flow to trace, because the defect is a relation between a principal and a resource: who has authorization to act on what. A route is vulnerable when that relation is not enforced or is enforced incorrectly.
paragraphs.zh: 与 SQL 注入的对比揭示了为何破碎的访问控制在源代码中难以检测（图）。 在注入攻击中，缺陷表现为一条流程：请求参数以能够改变数据库查询语句的形式传入。 在所有应用程序中，被违反的属性都是相同的，因此静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具会针对某种语言编写一次规则，从而追踪这些流程。 破碎的访问控制没有可追踪的流程，因为其缺陷是主体与资源之间的关系：谁有权对什么执行操作。 当这种关系未被强制执行或执行错误时，某个路径就会存在漏洞。

paragraphs.en: SAST analyzers such as CodeQL and Semgrep [ 14 , 35 ] carry authorization rules, but these test the presence of a conventional framework-specific guard, which is a syntactic fact that a pattern can match. Whether it is the right guard for the object that returns the route depends on the intended policy of the application under analysis, so no generalizable set of patterns can be written, and the class remains largely beyond the reach of the analyzes that make injection detectable [ 24 ] . Detecting a missing or wrong check requires knowing which one the operation needs, and today that knowledge comes from one of two sources. The first is dynamic testing, which sends requests to the running application on different accounts and compares the responses [ 34 , 32 , 25 , 10 ] . The second is manual review, which recovers the knowledge directly but requires an engineer to read the source route by route. Checking authorization from source is therefore a reading task. This paper asks whether that reading can be automated: whether the property each route is meant to guarantee can be recovered from the source and the code held to it, so that a reviewer verifies findings instead of performing the analysis.
paragraphs.zh: SAST 分析工具（如 CodeQL 和 Semgrep [ 14 , 35 ]）包含授权规则，但这些规则仅测试是否存在特定的框架专用防护机制——这是一种模式可以匹配到的语法事实。 该防护机制是否适用于返回路由的对象，取决于被分析应用程序的预期策略，因此无法编写一套通用的模式集合，这类问题在很大程度上仍超出能够检测注入行为的分析能力 [ 24 ] 。 要检测缺失或错误的检查逻辑，需要明确操作所需的具体检查类型，而目前这种知识来自两个来源之一。 第一个来源是动态测试：向运行中的应用发送不同账户的请求，并比较响应结果 [ 34 , 32 , 25 , 10 ] 。 第二个来源是人工审查：直接从代码中获取相关知识，但需要工程师逐条阅读源代码中的路由逻辑。 因此，从源代码层面检查授权本质上是一项阅读任务。 本文探讨的是这种阅读任务能否实现自动化：即能否从源代码和与之对应的代码规范中推导出每条路由应保证的属性，从而让审查人员只需验证分析结果，而非亲自执行分析过程。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are currently the closest automated approximation to an engineer reading code. A model can read a route’s handler together with the data model behind it and the conventions of the framework it is built on, and infer from them what that route is meant to enforce. However, left to read without direction, a model judges security properties unreliably [ 39 ] . Absentia is a scaffolding that supplies the direction in two steps: first, it maps the application’s request surface into a graph of routes and the guards in front of them, and then audits that surface one route at a time by invariant falsification , inferring the properties each route is meant to guarantee and checking the code against them. A route where an invariant fails becomes a finding for a security reviewer to verify.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，大型语言模型（LLM）是自动化程度最高、最接近工程师阅读代码的近似方案。 一个模型可以读取某个路由的处理程序、其背后的数据模型以及所基于框架的约定，并据此推断该路由旨在强制执行什么。 然而，如果让模型在没有指导的情况下自行判断，它会对安全属性做出不可靠的评估 [ 39 ] 。 Absentia 是一种提供指导的脚手架工具，分两步完成：首先，它将应用程序的请求表面映射为路由图及其前方的守卫；然后，通过不变量证伪的方式逐个审计这些路由，推断每个路由旨在保证的属性，并据此检查代码是否符合要求。 当某个路由的不变量失效时，该问题就会成为安全评审员需要验证的发现项。

paragraphs.en: To validate Absentia , we assemble a benchmark of real authorization vulnerabilities: 30 disclosed advisories spanning 25 open-source applications and 9 frameworks, in Python (18), TypeScript (9), and JavaScript (3). Each advisory was published in 2025 or later, which limits what an evaluated model could have seen in training (§ ), and every instance was verified by a human auditor. Each instance carries a vulnerable and a fixed commit, so recall is scored together with a patched-commit differential that credits a detection only when the defect is reported on the vulnerable version and not on the fixed one. To assess whether Absentia is specific to authorization, we also run it on the injection categories of the OWASP Benchmark in Python and Java [ 31 , 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证 Absentia，我们构建了一个真实授权漏洞的基准数据集：包含 30 条已披露的安全建议，涵盖 25 个开源应用和 9 种框架，涉及 Python（18）、TypeScript（9）和 JavaScript（3）。 每条安全建议均发布于 2025 年或之后，这限制了评估模型在训练阶段可能接触到的信息（§），且每个实例都经过人工审计员的验证。 每个实例都包含一个存在漏洞的提交和一个已修复的提交，因此召回率会与修复后的提交差异一同评分：只有当缺陷在存在漏洞的版本中被报告，而在修复版本中未被报告时，该检测才会被计为有效。 为了评估 Absentia 是否专门针对授权问题，我们还在 Python 和 Java 环境中，基于 OWASP 基准测试的注入类别对其进行了测试 [31, 30]。

paragraphs.en: The experiments yield three results. Broken access control is detectable from source: Absentia recalls 19 of the 30 vulnerabilities, 17 of them under the patched-commit differential, at 51% verifier-adjudicated precision, while CodeQL and Semgrep recall none, an outcome consistent with a limit of expressiveness rather than of reach. What separates Absentia from a model left to itself is direction rather than capability: an unstructured agent on the same model, run on the same repositories as a control, recalls 3 of the 30. The same configuration reaches beyond that class: on the injection categories of the OWASP Benchmark it leads every tool we run in Python and trails only CodeQL and IRIS in Java. Together, they attribute the detection to the procedure rather than to the model: an analysis that recovers, route by route, the property the application intended to enforce, and treats it as a claim to falsify. The scaffolding converts a model’s capacity to read code into that analysis.

paragraphs.en: We propose Absentia , a scaffolding that directs general LLM agents to analyze source code systematically , built on request-surface mapping, per-route invariant falsification, and the composition of findings across routes. Because what a route must guarantee is recovered from the application under audit rather than written in advance, Absentia runs unchanged on frameworks and languages it was not built for, and it reaches broken access control, a class that dataflow analyses miss in most cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Absentia，这是一种指导通用 LLM 智能体系统分析源代码的框架，其构建基于请求-表面映射、每条路径的不变性证伪，以及跨路径的发现结果组合。 由于一条路径必须保证的内容是从被审计的应用程序中恢复出来的，而非预先写定的，因此 Absentia 在未为其构建的框架和语言上也能正常运行且无需修改，并且能够检测出数据流分析在多数情况下会遗漏的一类问题——破坏性的访问控制。

paragraphs.en: We construct and release BAC-Bench , a broken access control benchmark : 30 disclosed advisories across 25 repositories, 3 languages, and 9 frameworks, each published in 2025 or later, verified by a human auditor against its advisory and fix commit, scored by recall and a patched-commit differential.

paragraphs.en: Our experiments show that scaffolding turns a general agent into a detector : Absentia recalls 19 of the 30 vulnerabilities at 51% verifier-adjudicated precision, where CodeQL and Semgrep recall none and an unstructured agent on the same model recalls 3. When the components are separated, the per-route decomposition accounts for the recall, and invariant falsification cuts report volume by a third at no cost to it. We also report costs and how much of previous computations can be avoided when a repository is re-analyzed after a commit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验表明，脚手架机制能将一个通用智能体转变为检测器：Absentia 在验证者裁定精度为 51% 的情况下，从 30 个漏洞中召回了 19 个，而 CodeQL 和 Semgrep 均未召回任何漏洞，同一模型上的非结构化智能体仅召回了 3 个。 当各组件被分离时，每条路径的分解能够解释召回率，且不变式反例报告量在成本不变的情况下减少了三分之一。 我们还报告了相关成本，以及在提交后重新分析仓库时，先前计算中有多少部分可以被避免。

paragraphs.en: Web-application vulnerabilities fall into two families [ 13 , 38 ] : common flaws, detectable without any model of what the application is meant to do, and application-specific flaws, invisible without one. Injection is the standard example of a common flaw. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and command injection share a common abstraction: untrusted input reaches a dangerous operation without being made safe first [ 26 ] . That definition is written once for a language and its libraries, by naming which functions read input from a request and which operations must not receive that input unchecked. It then applies unchanged to every application written in that language. The defect is a property of a dataflow between those two sets of functions, and this is the taint signature that an analysis can trace directly.
paragraphs.zh: 网络应用漏洞可分为两类 [ 13 , 38 ]：通用缺陷（无需了解应用预期功能即可检测）和应用特定缺陷（必须了解应用功能才能发现）。 注入攻击是通用缺陷的标准示例。 SQL 注入、跨站脚本和命令注入有一个共同抽象特征：未经信任的输入在未经安全处理的情况下直接触发了危险操作 [ 26 ]。 该定义只需针对一种语言和其库编写一次，通过明确指定哪些函数从请求中读取输入，以及哪些操作不得未经检查地接收这些输入即可实现。 此后，该定义将无差别地适用于用这种语言编写的每一款应用。 这一缺陷是这两组函数之间数据流的属性，而这就是分析可以直接追踪的污染签名。

paragraphs.en: Broken access control (BAC, OWASP A01:2025 [ 33 ] ) is the failure of authorization : the policy that decides which principals may act on which resources. We write that policy as a relation, 𝑝𝑒𝑟𝑚𝑖𝑡𝑡𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( u , r ) \mathit{permitted}(u,r) , asking whether principal u u may act on resource r r [ 24 ] . Unlike the source and sink specifications used by conventional taint analyses, the relevant authorization relation is usually application-specific. A taint analysis can determine whether request-derived data reaches a sensitive operation, but it does not by itself encode whether that operation is permitted for this principal and resource. Detecting the defect therefore requires either an application-specific policy specification or a procedure that recovers a candidate policy from the application under analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 访问控制漏洞（BAC，OWASP A01:2025 [ 33 ]）是指授权机制的失效：即决定哪些主体可以操作哪些资源的策略未能正确执行。 我们将该策略表示为一个关系式 𝑝𝑒𝑟𝑚𝑖𝑡𝑡𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( u , r ) \mathit{permitted}(u,r)，用于判断主体 u 是否可以操作资源 r [ 24 ]。 与传统的污染分析所使用的源和汇规格不同，相关的授权关系通常是特定于应用程序的。 污染分析可以确定请求派生出的数据是否到达了敏感操作，但它本身并未编码该操作是否被允许由当前主体对当前资源执行。 因此，要检测此类缺陷，要么需要特定于应用程序的策略规范，要么需要一个能够从被分析的应用程序中恢复候选策略的流程。

We first state the setting in which that property has to be recovered, and the failures we claim to detect. A short example then shows that difference inside one application, and three obstacles follow from it. Those obstacles imply three requirements, and § presents the scaffolding built to meet them.

paragraphs.en: Setting. Absentia is run by an application’s own developers and security engineers, as an audit of code they maintain. White-box access is therefore the natural setting for it. Absentia reads the application’s source code, with no running instance, no credentials, and no live endpoint. It reports the access-control defects it finds so that they can be fixed. A defect only has meaning relative to a principal, so we fix one reference point. A violation is what an authenticated but low-privilege principal, for instance an ordinary user, can do beyond what that principal is permitted: a request for which 𝑝𝑒𝑟𝑚𝑖𝑡𝑡𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( u , r ) \mathit{permitted}(u,r) fails. Finally, Absentia detects rather than exploits: it reports what a request would have to do to violate the policy, which is what a maintainer needs in order to confirm the defect and fix it.

paragraphs.en: Scope. We take broken access control in the sense of § . A route falls in scope when the application would accept a request that reaches data or functionality the requesting principal is not entitled to, whether no check stands in the way or one does and enforces the wrong relation. The advisories behind our instances name this failure in two main ways. One is CWE-639, where a request supplies the identifier of an object another principal owns and the application does not verify that the caller is entitled to it, commonly called an insecure direct object reference (IDOR). The other is CWE-862, missing authorization, where an operation performs no entitlement check at all. § reports how the instances fall across these labels.

paragraphs.en: Figure shows two vulnerabilities from the same application, reduced to their essential shape. Both routes are declared in the same file, and both carry the same authentication check, @login_required , on line 2. In Figure (a) the caller controls the query parameter q , which line 5 inserts into the SQL string handed to db.execute , so the caller can change the query itself, not only the text it searches for. Figure (b) takes an invoice identifier from the request path and returns the invoice carrying that identifier (line 4). Invoices belong to accounts in this application. The @login_required check passes for any logged-in caller, and the query selects the invoice by identifier alone, so nothing confirms that the invoice belongs to the caller’s account, and any authenticated user can read any invoice by supplying its identifier. paragraphs.en: O1: The property to be checked is not the same in every application. An injection rule is written before the application exists: user input must reach a query only in a form that cannot alter it, in Figure (a) as in any codebase. Nothing plays that role in Figure (b) , whose handler would be correct, unchanged, in an application where invoices are shared documents. What makes it a defect is a property of this application alone: an invoice has an owning account, and only that account may read it. No rule carries that property in from outside, so it must be established for this route, from the code of this application, before that code can be checked against it. This is why the static analyzers we run report none of the 30 vulnerabilities in BAC-Bench (§ ).

paragraphs.en: O2: A missing check is a claim about the whole application, not about a line. Whether it is a defect depends on something the line does not contain: it is wrong only if nothing anywhere else has already kept the caller to their own invoices. paragraphs.en: O3: A model reading the same code has the capacity but no procedure. A language model can read a route’s handler and the data model behind it and work out what that route is meant to allow. What it does not have is a way to work through an application. Two things are missing. The first is coverage: the applications in our benchmark expose a median of 220 routes and as many as 999 (§ ), and an agent handed a repository and asked to look for access-control flaws reads whichever parts draw its attention, leaving no record of what it did not read. The second is a standard against which to judge: on a route it does read, whether the code looks wrong has no fixed answer, and the models decide from the surface features of the code rather than from what the route was meant to allow [ 39 ] . In our evaluation, an unstructured agent using the same model detects 3 of 30 advisories, compared to 19 for Absentia (§ ). The result motivates testing whether explicit coverage, rather than the underlying model alone, accounts for the difference.

paragraphs.en: Three requirements follow. R1: The analysis must recover the application’s request surface before it judges any of it, since whatever enforces a route need not sit near it, and applications differ in way they declare routes and attach guards. R2: It must then proceed over that surface route by route, so that what is read is settled in advance rather than by what draws an agent’s attention. R3: It must establish the property a route is meant to guarantee before checking the code against it, and report a finding as the request that would violate that property rather than as a judgment, since no rule supplies it in advance and a model asked only whether code looks wrong has no standard to answer against. § presents the scaffolding that meets them (Figure ), together with a stage that composes findings across routes and one that reuses verdicts a later commit cannot have changed.
paragraphs.zh: 以下有三项要求。 R1：分析必须在判断任何内容之前，先恢复出应用程序的请求表面，因为强制执行路由的机制未必紧邻该路由，而不同应用程序声明路由和附加守卫的方式也各不相同。 R2：随后必须逐条遍历该表面的各个路由，从而确保读取的内容是预先确定的，而不是由吸引智能体注意力的内容所决定。 R3：在将代码与某条路由进行比对之前，必须先确立该路由旨在保证的属性，并以可能违反该属性的请求形式报告发现结果，而非以判断形式报告，因为没有任何规则能提前提供这一属性，而一个仅被问及代码是否存在问题的模型也没有可供对照的标准。§ 部分介绍了满足这些要求的框架（图），以及一个用于跨路由整合发现结果的阶段，和一个可重用裁决、且后续提交无法更改的机制。

paragraphs.en: Absentia takes the source of one application and returns findings, each naming a property that one route is meant to guarantee together with the request that would violate it. This section presents the scaffolding that produces them. § builds a graph of the application’s request surface, so that what will be analyzed is settled before any of its in-depth code reading. § then analyzes each route in that graph on its own, and fixes what a finding has to contain. § links findings across routes, for violations that no single route reveals. § reuses the verdicts that a later commit cannot affect, since an application under development is analyzed more than once.
paragraphs.zh: Absentia 以某个应用程序为起点，返回一系列发现结果，每个结果都指明了一条路由本应保障的属性，以及可能违反该属性的请求。 本节介绍了生成这些结果的框架。§ 会构建应用程序请求表面的图结构，从而在深入阅读代码之前便确定分析对象。§ 接着对图中的每条路由进行独立分析，并明确每个发现结果必须包含的内容。§ 还会关联不同路由之间的发现结果，以识别任何单一路由都无法揭示的违规情况。§ 会复用后续提交无法影响的判定结果，因为开发中的应用程序可能需要多次分析。

Real applications make that a search through a great deal of code: the backends in our benchmark hold a median of 151 thousand lines and the largest more than a million (§ ), of which the code that serves requests is only a small part. paragraphs.en: A security engineer auditing the same application does not read files at random [ 34 ] . They first orient themselves, working out what the application is built on, because that is what tells them where the code worth reading lives. Only then do they work through the application’s surface, route by route, asking of each what it exposes and what stands in front of it.
paragraphs.zh: 审计同一应用程序的安全工程师并不会随机读取文件 [ 34 ] 。 他们首先会确定方向，弄清楚应用程序是基于什么构建的，因为正是这一点能让他们知道哪些代码值得阅读。 只有在那之后，他们才会逐条路线地遍历应用程序的表面，对每条路线询问它暴露了什么以及其前方有什么。

paragraphs.en: Absentia follows the same order. The surface has to be found before it can be worked through, so Absentia first maps it into a graph [ 7 ] . That graph records where each route is declared, the code that serves it, the authorization checks the application declares, the request values that code reads, and the sensitive operations behind them, such as the database queries and the writes into the response. Each of these is recorded as a file and a line, and the graph records which of them belong to the same route. Figure shows an example of what the graph could hold for one route, whose elements were all declared in the same file. The graph settles what will be analyzed and where to look, and judges none of it; judgment happens one route at a time (§ ).
paragraphs.zh: Absentia 遵循相同的顺序。 必须先找到表面，然后才能对其进行处理，因此 Absentia 首先将其映射为一个图 [ 7 ] 。 该图记录了每条路线的声明位置、为其服务的代码、应用程序声明的授权检查、该代码读取的请求值，以及它们背后的敏感操作，例如数据库查询和对响应的写入。 这些内容中的每一项都被记录为一个文件和一行，而该图则记录了哪些项属于同一条路线。 图示展示了该图可能为某条路线存储的内容示例，其所有元素都在同一文件中声明。 该图决定了需要分析的内容和查找的位置，但不对任何内容进行判断；判断是逐条路线进行的（§）。

paragraphs.en: However, two applications rarely declare their routes in the same way. A framework sets the broad conventions, the version narrows them, and the application then wraps them in helpers and base classes of its own, so the expressions precise enough to locate a route, a request value, a query or a guard are usually particular to one application. Absentia therefore has an LLM write them, since a model can recognize the conventions it has seen during training and can also work out unfamiliar ones from the code. Two passes follow: profiling establishes what the application is built on, and extraction produces the expressions that locate each kind of element.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，两个应用程序很少以相同的方式声明其路由。 框架设定了宽泛的约定，版本进一步限定了这些约定，而应用程序则用其自身的辅助函数和基类对这些约定进行封装，因此，足以定位路由、请求值、查询或守卫的表达式通常特定于某个应用程序。 因此，Absentia 会由一个大型语言模型来编写这些表达式，因为模型能够识别训练过程中见过的约定，也能根据代码推断出陌生的约定。 接下来是两次处理：分析用于确定应用程序构建的基础，而提取则生成定位各类元素的表达式。

paragraphs.en: Profiling. An agent lists the directory layout, opens the dependency manifests, and searches for the imports that show which of the declared dependencies the code actually uses. It reports a short list of labels: the framework and language, the data stores and the libraries the application queries them through, and the libraries by which it authenticates its callers. For Indico, a conference-management application among the 25 of § , that list reads Flask over Python, PostgreSQL and SQLite through SQLAlchemy, and sessions and OAuth through Flask-Multipass. The same report answers one further question: how this application decides who may see which records. Some applications separate callers by ownership of a record, others by ranked roles, and others by both. That choice is a property of the application rather than of its framework. The agent has to work it out from the code. Without that answer, a handler that returns the record named in a request cannot be judged correct or incorrect.
paragraphs.zh: 特征分析。 智能体列出目录结构，打开依赖关系清单，并搜索导入项，以确定代码实际使用了哪些已声明的依赖项。 它会报告一个简短的标签列表：框架和语言、数据仓库以及应用查询这些仓库所用的库，还有用于验证调用者身份所用的库。 对于 Indico（第 § 节所列 25 个应用之一，一个会议管理应用），该列表为：基于 Python 的 Flask、通过 SQLAlchemy 使用的 PostgreSQL 和 SQLite，以及通过 Flask-Multipass 管理的会话和 OAuth。 同一份报告还回答了另一个问题：该应用如何决定谁可以查看哪些记录。 一些应用根据记录的所有权区分调用者，另一些则依据等级分明的角色，还有一些则同时使用这两种方式。 这种选择属于应用本身，而非其框架的特性。 智能体必须从代码中分析出这一点。 如果没有这个答案，就无法判断一个返回请求中所指定记录的处理程序是否正确或错误。

paragraphs.en: Extraction. Obtaining these profiling labels is worth a pass of its own because they narrow what the extraction agents have to look for. Knowing that the application is Flask does not say which expressions declare its routes, but it does say which family of expressions to expect, and the same holds for a query issued through SQLAlchemy or a caller identified through Flask-Multipass. An extraction agent therefore starts from a known framework, data layer and authentication library, and has only to recover the expressions this application reaches each one through.
paragraphs.zh: 提取。 获取这些特征标签本身就有价值，因为它们能缩小提取智能体需要查找的范围。 知道该应用是 Flask，并不能说明哪些表达式声明了其路由，但能说明应预期哪一类表达式；通过 SQLAlchemy 发出的查询或通过 Flask-Multipass 识别的调用者也遵循同样的规则。 因此，提取智能体从一个已知的框架、数据层和身份验证库出发，只需恢复该应用通过它们访问每个组件所用的表达式即可。

paragraphs.en: With that report, the application is read again, this time in depth. An agent opens its routing and handler files and reports, for each kind of element, which expression marks it and which files to search for that expression. For Indico the answers come back as the expressions particular to it: _bp.add_url_rule for a route declaration, request.view_args for a request value, db.session for a query, session.user for the caller. Two agents do this independently and their reports are unioned.
paragraphs.zh: 借助这份报告，应用程序会被再次读取，这一次是深度读取。 一个智能体会打开其路由和处理程序文件以及报告，针对每种类型的元素，说明哪个表达式标记了它，以及需要搜索哪些文件来查找该表达式。 对于 Indico，返回的答案是其特有的表达式：用于路线声明的 _bp.add_url_rule、用于请求值的 request.view_args、用于查询的 db.session，以及用于调用者的 session.user。 两个智能体独立执行此操作，并将它们的报告进行合并。

paragraphs.en: Absentia applies the crafted patterns deterministically, and every match becomes an element of the graph once duplicates and false matches are dropped. A route no pattern matches is absent from the graph and from every stage after it, which is why the two reports are unioned rather than either taken alone. Because one declaration can serve several HTTP verbs, a further pass reads the source around each route to settle its method and path, and expands it into one route per method, so that the surface is a set of routes rather than of registration sites.
paragraphs.zh: Absentia 会确定性地应用这些精心设计的模式，一旦去除重复项和错误匹配，每个匹配都会成为图中的元素。 没有模式匹配的路线不会出现在图中，也不会出现在其后的任何阶段，因此这两份报告会被合并，而不是单独采用其中一份。 由于一个声明可以服务于多个 HTTP 动词，因此需要进一步处理：读取每个路线周围的源数据以确定其方法和路径，并将其扩展为每种方法对应一条路线，从而使表面呈现为一组路线，而非一组注册站点。

paragraphs.en: Per-route decomposition. By default, Absentia analyzes every route in the graph. A handler that looks harmless can still be the one missing a check, so it is safer to read every route once than to leave one out. Reading every route is also where most of the cost of running Absentia falls, and § reports that cost together with the share of route verdicts that carry over when a repository is re-analyzed at a later commit.

paragraphs.en: An agent receives the graph’s record of its route (Figure ), which names the registration site and the code that the graph linked to it, and it opens that code itself. It reads the handler first and then follows the calls out of it, into the services and data models behind it, as far as it takes to see where each input is consumed and where each response field is produced. The rest of the application stays outside its context unless it goes looking, so how much code one agent holds at once is set by the route it was given rather than by the size of the application around it.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体接收图中记录其路线的信息（图），其中标明了注册站点以及图与之关联的代码，然后它自己打开该代码。 它首先读取处理程序，然后按照其中的调用顺序，深入其背后的服务和数据模型，直到能够确定每个输入被消耗的位置以及每个响应字段被生成的位置。 除非主动去查找，否则应用程序的其余部分都保持在智能体的上下文之外，因此一个智能体同时持有的代码量取决于其被赋予的路线，而非周围应用程序的大小。

paragraphs.en: Invariant falsification. Everything so far settles what to read; this step decides whether a defect is found. The agent takes one route at a time and works through it in a fixed order. It first enumerates the properties the route is meant to guarantee. For each, it then locates the code that is supposed to enforce it. Finally, it tries to falsify each by describing a request that the endpoint would accept and that the property forbids.
paragraphs.zh: 不变性证伪。 到目前为止，所有内容都确定了需要读取的内容；这一步则决定是否发现了缺陷。 智能体每次只选择一条路径，并按照固定的顺序进行处理。 它首先枚举该路径应保证的属性。 然后，针对每个属性，它定位到负责强制执行该属性的代码。 最后，它通过描述一个端点会接受但该属性所禁止的请求，来尝试对每个属性进行证伪。

paragraphs.en: The properties are the agent’s own. It states each in plain language, after reading the handler and the data model behind it, as a claim about this route in this application. Figure shows one: an invoice is returned only to the account that owns it, which holds in the application of § and would not hold in one where invoices are shared. Recovering the properties a program is expected to satisfy is the aim of Daikon [ 12 ] and of work applying it to logic flaws in web applications [ 13 ] . paragraphs.zh: 这些属性属于智能体自身。 在读取处理程序及其背后的数据模型之后，它以关于此应用程序中该路线的断言形式，用通俗易懂的语言逐一陈述这些属性。 图展示了一个例子：发票只会返回给其所有者账户；在该应用程序的 § 部分中，该账户拥有此发票，而在共享发票的应用程序中则不会如此。 Daikon [12] 以及将其应用于网络应用程序逻辑缺陷的研究 [13] 的目标，都是恢复程序应满足的属性。 两者都通过程序的执行过程来恢复这些属性，但 Absentia 则是从源代码中推断出它们。

paragraphs.en: An enforced property produces no report. A missing or insufficient enforcement produces a finding with a fixed schema: the candidate invariant, the relevant code locations, the request shape, the preconditions under which it applies, and the effect that would demonstrate the violation (Figure ). The agent can write those only from code it has read, so the form gives it nowhere to put a suspicion it cannot ground in source, and the precision this buys is what § measures.
paragraphs.zh: 强制执行的属性不会产生任何报告。 执行缺失或不充分会产生一个具有固定结构的发现：候选不变量、相关的代码位置、请求格式、其适用的前提条件，以及能够证明违规的影响（图）。 智能体只能根据已读取的代码编写这些内容，因此该形式没有地方可以放置无法在源代码中依据的怀疑，而由此获得的精确度正是 § 所衡量的。

paragraphs.en: Findings are not always bound to a single route: what is minor on one route can be serious once a second route is in play. Absentia therefore has each agent record, besides its findings, the behaviors of its route that break no invariant but would matter if a second route did something in particular: a capability, written down as the behavior, what the caller controls in it, and what would have to hold elsewhere. Figure shows the shape of it. An upload that stores a file under a name the caller chooses is a capability, harmless while nothing serves that store back to callers. A second route that does serve files out of it, without checking what they are, is a small matter on its own, since that route can assume the store holds what the application itself put there. Together they let a caller control what the application serves to anyone who asks, and an agent reading either route alone has no cause to report it.
paragraphs.zh: 发现结果并不总是局限于单一路线：在一条路线上看似无关紧要的情况，一旦第二条路线被启用，就可能变得严重。 因此，Absentia 要求每个智能体除了记录其发现结果外，还需记录其路线中那些未违反任何不变量但会在第二条路线执行特定操作时产生影响的行為：即一项能力，以行為形式记录下来，包括调用者对其的控制内容，以及其他地方必须满足的条件。 该图展示了其形态。 一个以调用者选择的名称存储文件的上传操作是一项能力；只要没有任何机制将存储的内容返回给调用者，这项能力就是无害的。 第二条路线若未经检查直接从中提供文件，单独来看这只是一个小问题，因为该路线可以假设存储的内容正是应用程序本身放入其中的。 两者结合后，允许调用者控制应用程序向任何请求者提供的内容；而仅读取其中一条路线的智能体则没有理由报告此事。

paragraphs.en: Pairs like that are what Absentia looks for once every route has been analyzed. Two routes declared in different places still meet in the code they act on, so Absentia matches the findings and capabilities located in the same file, and gives each pair to an agent that reads both routes and that shared code before it reports the composition. § reports how far this stage was exercised on BAC-Bench .

paragraphs.en: An audit is not a single event. An application under development has to be checked repeatedly, so that a defect is found before it ships rather than after, which puts Absentia on a sequence of commits rather than on one snapshot. Analyzing every route in the graph is what makes its coverage systematic (§ ), but also what a run spends its budget on. Absentia therefore decides, between two commits, which of the previous run’s verdicts still stand and can be reused.
paragraphs.zh: 审计并非单一事件。 处于开发中的应用需要反复检查，以便在发布前发现缺陷而非发布后；这意味着 Absentia 需要关注一系列提交，而不仅仅是某个快照。 分析图中每一条路径使其覆盖范围具有系统性（§），但这也是单次运行会消耗预算的原因。 因此，Absentia 会在两次提交之间决定：哪些先前运行的判定结果仍然有效并可以重复使用。

paragraphs.en: That decision reads each commit’s graph together with the files the diff between them changed. Since a graph names the files every route is built from, a verdict from the earlier commit comes with the set of files it was read from, widened along the imports those files declare so that code the route reaches through another file counts as its own. Absentia keeps that verdict when no file in that set appears in the diff and all of them are byte-identical across the two commits, and analyzes the route again otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 该决策会将每次提交的图与它们之间的差异所修改的文件一同读取。 由于图命名了每条路径构建所用的所有文件，因此来自较早提交的判定会附带其读取的文件集，并沿着这些文件声明的导入关系进行扩展，使得路径通过其他文件访问到的代码也被视为其自身的一部分。 如果该集合中的任何文件未出现在差异中，且所有文件在两次提交之间字节完全相同，Absentia 将保留该判定；否则，它会重新分析该路径。

paragraphs.en: BAC-Bench is a benchmark for broken access control detection from source code. It holds 30 disclosed authorization advisories, each validated by a human auditor, drawn from 25 open-source projects. Each instance is the code of one project at the commit where the disclosed defect was live, paired with the commit that fixed it.
paragraphs.zh: BAC-Bench 是一个用于从源代码中检测访问控制缺陷的基准测试。 它包含 30 个已披露的授权问题通告，每个通告都经过人工审计员的验证，并来自 25 个开源项目。 每个实例都是某个项目在缺陷披露时生效的代码版本，以及与修复该缺陷的代码提交相对应的版本。

sents.zh: BAC-Bench 是一个用于从源代码中检测访问控制缺陷的基准测试。

sents.zh: 每个实例都是某个项目在缺陷披露时生效的代码版本，以及与修复该缺陷的代码提交相对应的版本。

paragraphs.en: Selection. An advisory becomes an instance when it concerns a web application written in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, and five conditions are guaranteed: (i) the advisory describes a genuine authorization defect, such as CWE-639 or CWE-862; (ii) a vulnerable commit exists at which the defect is live; (iii) a commit exists whose diff is the upstream fix for that defect; (iv) the advisory was published in 2025 or later; and (v) a security researcher has validated the instance against the advisory and the fix diff, correcting every field where the public record and the code disagreed.
paragraphs.zh: 选择。 当某个建议涉及用 Python、JavaScript 或 TypeScript 编写的 Web 应用程序，并且满足以下五个条件时，该建议即构成一个实例：(i) 该建议描述了一个真实的授权缺陷，例如 CWE-639 或 CWE-862；(ii) 存在一个包含该缺陷的易受攻击提交；(iii) 存在一个提交，其差异是该缺陷的上游修复；(iv) 该建议发布于 2025 年或之后；以及 (v) 一名安全研究人员已根据该建议和修复差异验证了此实例，并修正了公开记录与代码之间所有不一致的字段。

paragraphs.en: The oracle. The oracle for an instance is the advisory together with the vulnerable code and the fix diff. It records the invariant the route was meant to guarantee, the way the code breaks it, the routes affected, and two sets of locations. The first is the files named in the advisory and in the pull request that fixed it. The second is the lines the fix changed, mapped back to the range they occupied in the vulnerable code. § uses the second to separate a finding that points at the defect from one that points only at its neighborhood.
paragraphs.zh: 预言机。 某个实例的预言机是建议文件、脆弱代码以及修复差异的集合。 它记录了该路线原本旨在保证的不变量、代码破坏该不变量的方式、受影响的路线，以及两组位置集合。 第一组是建议文件中以及用于修复该问题的拉取请求中命名的文件。 第二组是修复所更改的代码行，并映射回它们在脆弱代码中原本占据的范围。§ 使用第二组来区分指向缺陷的发现与仅指向其邻近区域的发现。

sents.en: The oracle.

paragraphs.en: Each instance names the one bug its advisory identifies, and we ask only whether a tool reported that bug. At the commit that fixed it, we expect no tool to report that bug. Both questions are narrow by design. A large application may contain several authorization bugs, a single commit may contain more than one, and some are never disclosed, so we do not know every defect a repository contains and do not ask a tool to enumerate them. The negative is therefore specific to the bug under test, since the fixed version still holds whatever nobody has disclosed. Findings that name other weaknesses in the same repository are neither credited nor penalized, and precision is measured separately in § .
paragraphs.zh: 每个实例都会命名其顾问所识别出的那个漏洞，而我们只询问是否有工具报告了该漏洞。 在修复该漏洞的提交中，我们期望没有任何工具报告该漏洞。 这两个问题在设计上都是范围有限的。 一个大型应用可能包含多个授权漏洞，单个提交可能包含不止一个，而有些漏洞从未被披露，因此我们并不了解仓库中包含的所有缺陷，也不会要求工具将其全部列举出来。 因此，否定情况是特定于正在测试的漏洞的，因为修复后的版本仍然保留着那些尚未被披露的任何问题。 在相同仓库中发现的其他弱点既不会被加分也不会被扣分，其精确度将在 § 中单独衡量。

paragraphs.en: Deciding whether an instance was detected must not bias the evidence format of any one tool. A static analyzer reports a file, a line, a rule identifier and a short message [ 35 , 14 ] , where an agent may additionally report more detailed outputs such as a rationale in prose. Findings also arrive in volume, so the procedure has to settle many of them with as little human effort as possible. We therefore adjudicate every tool through the same two stages.
paragraphs.zh: 判断某个实例是否被检测到时，不得对任何单一工具的证据格式产生偏见。 静态分析器会报告一个文件、一行代码、规则标识符和一条简短消息 [ 35 , 14 ]，而智能体还可以额外报告更详细的输出，例如以散文形式呈现的推理过程。 此外，发现结果的数量也很大，因此该流程必须尽可能减少人工干预，处理大量结果。 因此，我们通过相同的两个阶段来裁定每个工具的结果。

paragraphs.en: The location gate. The first stage is deterministic, and its goal is to filter out the findings that do not concern the bug under focus. A finding survives when its location overlaps the instance’s implicated files or when its route matches an affected route. For example, across the vulnerable commits of all 30 instances Semgrep reports 6,398 findings, of which only 66 move forward.
paragraphs.zh: 位置门。 第一阶段是确定性的，其目标是过滤掉与当前关注的漏洞无关的发现。 当一个发现的位置与该实例涉及的文件重叠，或者其路径与受影响的路径匹配时，该发现才能保留下来。 例如，在全部 30 个实例的易受攻击提交中，Semgrep 报告了 6,398 个发现，但其中只有 66 个被保留下来。

paragraphs.en: The judge. The second stage is where a detection is decided. The gate leaves few candidates per instance, so we can afford a language model as judge (Claude Sonnet 4.6 [ 3 ] ) that reads each one against the invariant and the way the code breaks it. It is not told which tool produced the finding, and it runs at temperature zero. It also reads no repository source, so it adjudicates the claim a tool made rather than re-analyzing the code on that tool’s behalf.
paragraphs.zh: 法官。 第二阶段是做出检测决定的阶段。 该门控机制每个实例仅保留少数候选项，因此我们可以使用语言模型作为法官（Claude Sonnet 4.6 [ 3 ]），通过阅读每个候选项与不变量的对比以及代码违反该不变量的方式来进行判断。 它不会被告知是哪个工具产生了这一发现，并且是以零温度运行的。 它也不会读取任何仓库源代码，因此它是基于某个工具提出的主张进行裁决，而不是代表该工具重新分析代码。

paragraphs.en: Validating the judge. Every recall number in this paper rests on a model’s judgment of what counts as a match, so we measured that judgment against a person’s. A graduate researcher in security replayed the judge’s task on every match it credited and a sample of its rejections, given the same oracle and the same finding text and shown neither the judge’s decision nor which tool produced the finding: the two agree on 81 of 85 adjudications, Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.91.
paragraphs.zh: 验证裁判。 本文中的每一条召回记录都依赖于模型对何为匹配的判断，因此我们将这种判断与人的判断进行了对比测量。 一位安全领域的研究生研究员对裁判所认可的每一条匹配结果以及部分被拒绝的结果重复执行了裁判任务，过程中使用了相同的预言机、相同的发现文本，且未向其展示裁判的决定或生成发现结果的工具：在85项裁定中，两者的结果一致81项，Cohen’s κ \kappa 值为0.91。

paragraphs.en: Absentia runs each stage of Figure as a Strands agent [ 1 ] over MiniMax-2.5 [ 6 ] . We choose this pairing for the setting of § , where the code under audit is often private and an organization may be unwilling to send it to a third-party service. Strands is open source and drives any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and MiniMax-2.5 is open-weight, so the whole pipeline can run inside that organization, on its own machines, under a local server such as vLLM [ 19 ] . We use AWS Bedrock in our experiments, but the method does not depend on it. The costs § reports are the tokens runs consumed at the rates that service charged for this model, $0.30 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output. Three further models appear in the evaluation, none of them inside Absentia : Claude Sonnet 4.6 [ 3 ] adjudicates detection (§ ), Claude Opus 4.8 [ 2 ] verifies precision and Claude Sonnet-5 [ 4 ] stands in as the stronger reader (§ ).
paragraphs.zh: Absentia 将 Figure 的每个阶段都以 Strands 智能体 [ 1 ] 的形式在 MiniMax-2.5 [ 6 ] 上运行。 对于 § 中的设置，我们选择了这种组合，因为在此设置中，待审计的代码通常是私有的，组织可能不愿将其发送到第三方服务。 Strands 是开源的，并且可以驱动任何兼容 OpenAI 的端点；而 MiniMax-2.5 也是开放权重的，因此整个流程可以在该组织内部、使用其自身的机器，并在本地服务器（如 vLLM [ 19 ] ）上运行。 我们在实验中使用 AWS Bedrock，但该方法并不依赖于它。 § 中报告的成本是运行时消耗的令牌数，按该服务对此模型收取的费率计算：每百万输入令牌 0.30 美元，每百万输出令牌 1.20 美元。 评估中还出现了另外三个模型，但均不在 Absentia 内部：Claude Sonnet 4.6 [ 3 ] 负责判定检测（§），Claude Opus 4.8 [ 2 ] 负责验证精确性，而 Claude Sonnet-5 [ 4 ] 则作为更强大的阅读器使用（§）。

paragraphs.en: Temperature is zero wherever a stage reasons about an individual route, though not in the stages that build the graph (§ ): extraction deliberately runs two agents at 0.1 and 0.7 and unions their reports, so that a route one pass misses can still be recovered by the other.

paragraphs.en: We first state the datasets, the baselines and the metrics (§ ), then report Absentia ’s detections on the benchmark of § , the contribution of each part of the scaffolding to that result, whether the same configuration reaches beyond authorization, and the cost of a run together with its amortization across commits (§ ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先介绍数据集、基线模型和评估指标（§），然后报告 Absentia 在 § 基准上的检测结果，框架各部分对该结果的贡献，相同配置是否超出了授权范围，以及单次运行的成本及其在各次提交中的摊销情况（§）。

paragraphs.en: Datasets. The evaluation spans two families of datasets. The first carries the main result: BAC-Bench , 30 disclosed broken-access-control advisories across 25 real Python, TypeScript and JavaScript web applications, with the patched-commit differential described in § .
paragraphs.zh: 数据集。 评估涵盖了两类数据集。 第一类呈现了主要结果：BAC-Bench，涉及 25 个真实 Python、TypeScript 和 JavaScript 网络应用程序中的 30 个已披露的访问控制漏洞通告，其修复提交差异在 § 中有描述。

paragraphs.en: The second family tests whether Absentia reaches beyond authorization: the OWASP Benchmarks in Python and in Java [ 31 , 30 ] . Each is a synthetic application labeled at construction, safe cases included, which lets us report a false-positive rate here and not on the authorization data. Their categories are broader than the vulnerabilities a source-to-sink analysis is meant to address, since they also cover classes such as weak randomness, insecure cookie flags and broken hashing. We therefore evaluate both Absentia and the baselines on the injection subset of each benchmark, which leaves 10 categories in Python and 6 in Java, among them SQL and command injection, cross-site scripting and path traversal. In total, there are 677 cases in Python, of which 240 are vulnerable, and 1,572 in Java, of which 819 are vulnerable.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个家族测试了 Absentia 是否超越了授权范围：Python 和 Java 中的 OWASP 基准测试 [31, 30]。 每个都是构建时已标记的合成应用（包括安全用例），这使我们能够在此报告假阳性率，而不是在授权数据上报告。 它们的类别比源到目标分析旨在解决的安全漏洞更为广泛，因为它们还涵盖了弱随机性、不安全 Cookie 标志和失效哈希等类别。 因此，我们在每个基准测试的注入子集上评估了 Absentia 和基线模型，其中 Python 剩余 10 个类别，Java 剩余 6 个类别，包括 SQL 和命令注入、跨站脚本和路径穿越。 总体而言，Python 中有 677 个用例，其中 240 个存在漏洞；Java 中有 1,572 个用例，其中 819 个存在漏洞。

sents.en: We therefore evaluate both Absentia and the baselines on the injection subset of each benchmark, which leaves 10 categories in Python and 6 in Java, among them SQL and command injection, cross-site scripting and path traversal.

sents.en: In total, there are 677 cases in Python, of which 240 are vulnerable, and 1,572 in Java, of which 819 are vulnerable.

paragraphs.en: We compare Absentia against five baselines, covering the three ways static analysis can reach these defects today: rules written in advance, a language model on its own, and the two combined. Two are standard static analyzers: CodeQL with its security-extended query suites, and Semgrep with the security, OWASP and language packs. Both are deterministic and have no language model. The third is IRIS [ 23 ] , in which a language model infers a repository’s taint source and sink specifications, those compile into CodeQL taint queries, and a second model pass filters the results. IRIS was released for Java only, so we keep the published implementation and re-implement the same method faithfully for Python. The fourth is RepoAudit [ 15 ] , an agentic data-flow analyzer that explores a repository and validates candidate paths with a model rather than compiling queries. The fifth, Plain LLM-Agent, is the unstructured control, asked to audit the repository end to end for 200 turns but without a route graph or per-route invariant falsification. To isolate the analysis from the model, all three model-driven baselines run on the model Absentia uses.

paragraphs.en: Baseline coverage differs by problem type. CodeQL, Semgrep and Plain LLM-Agent run on all 30 authorization instances. Plain LLM-Agent is the unstructured control and has to match Absentia ’s coverage. CodeQL and Semgrep are deterministic and free to run, so we sweep them in full even though we expect no detections. IRIS and RepoAudit run on injection only. Both are model-driven and priced per repository, and a sweep of either would return zeros set by what the tool can state, not by what the benchmark holds. RepoAudit ships no JavaScript or TypeScript analyzer, which puts 12 of the 30 instances out of reach, and its engine asks only whether a source reaches a sink. IRIS instantiates its method once per taint class and ships no authorization query; adding one would make the baseline our construction rather than the published method. The model budget goes to injection instead, where a flow is the right abstraction.
paragraphs.zh: 基线覆盖范围因问题类型而异。 CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Plain LLM-Agent 会在全部 30 个授权实例上运行。 Plain LLM-Agent 是非结构化对照组，必须与 Absentia 的覆盖范围保持一致。 CodeQL 和 Semgrep 是确定性的且可自由运行，因此即使我们预计不会有任何检测，也会对其进行全面扫描。 IRIS 和 RepoAudit 仅在注入场景下运行。 两者都是模型驱动并按仓库收费，对任一工具进行全面扫描都会返回该工具所能声明的零值集合，而非基准测试所涵盖的内容。 RepoAudit 未附带 JavaScript 或 TypeScript 分析器，导致 30 个实例中有 12 个无法覆盖，且其引擎仅判断某个源是否触达某个汇。 IRIS 会为每个污染类实例化一次其方法，但未提供授权查询；若添加此类查询，基线就会变成我们自己的构建方案，而非已发布的方法。 模型预算将转而用于注入场景，因为在该场景中，“流”是最合适的抽象概念。

paragraphs.en: Recall is the primary metric on BAC-Bench because its targets are real applications, where the vulnerabilities nobody has disclosed are unknown and the safe code therefore cannot be enumerated. On top of recall on the vulnerable commit we add two things: (i) a controlled negative, where each tool runs on the fixed commit of every instance as well, so that a finding persisting where the disclosed defect no longer exists is adjudicated as a false positive; and (ii) precision by verification, the share of a tool’s emitted findings that an independent verifier confirms against the code, which § reports together with a blinded human check of that verifier.
paragraphs.zh: 召回率是 BAC-Bench 的主要指标，因为其目标都是真实应用，而这些应用中尚未被披露的漏洞是未知的，因此无法穷举出安全的代码。 除了对存在漏洞的提交进行召回率评估外，我们还增加了两个要素：(i) 受控的负样本，即每个工具也会在所有实例的已修复提交上运行，这样当某个发现仍然存在但已披露的缺陷已不复存在时，即可判定其为误报；以及 (ii) 通过验证实现的精确率，即工具所报告的发现在独立验证者对照代码进行确认后的比例，§ 中会将其与对该验证者的盲测人工检查结果一并报告。

We run this experiment on the eight instances below 100 routes with k = 5 k{=}5 .

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Broken access control detection). How many disclosed BAC vulnerabilities does Absentia detect, does it stay silent on the commits that fixed them, and where does the recall it does not reach go?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（访问控制故障检测）。 Absentia 检测到了多少已披露的 BAC 漏洞？它是否对修复这些漏洞的提交保持沉默？而它的召回能力又未能覆盖哪些部分？

paragraphs.en: Detection recall. Absentia detects 19 of the 30 disclosed vulnerabilities, the two static analyzers detect none of them, and Plain LLM-Agent detects 3 (Table ). The analyzers are not short of reach: they scan the whole repository, so the code holding each defect is read on every instance, and across the vulnerable commits Semgrep alone emits 6,398 findings. They just end up being unhelpful because their query set, while vast, is generic, and the properties of authorization are specific to each of the applications.

paragraphs.en: Plain LLM-Agent, on the other hand, is affected by another issue, ineffective exploration. paragraphs.en: Two limits on this reading are worth stating. Raising k k can only expose more variation, which is what happened here: at k = 3 k{=}3 aegra was unanimous, and the two additional trials moved pass k from 0.62 down to 0.50.

paragraphs.en: Decomposition is what makes the vulnerabilities reachable, from 3 instances to 18, and adding falsification on top of it moves recall by one. What falsification does change is the volume: the average instance yields 77 reports rather than 119, a third fewer, with the disclosed defects still found. That much needs no judgment of report quality at all.

paragraphs.en: Verified precision. Falsification suppresses 42 reports per instance on average, and whether those were the right ones to suppress is a question of precision. Precision has no oracle here: these are production applications, and nothing certifies the code a report points at as safe unless that report is the disclosed defect. So we verify each report against the code instead. An independent agent using Claude Opus 4.8 [ 2 ] reads the repository and decides whether the code substantiates each report, over every instance, capped at 20 reports drawn at random from each configuration and never told which one wrote them. In its reading, the confirmed share rises from 40.5% to 50.8%, a paired gain of 10.3 points.

paragraphs.en: Since that verdict comes from a model, a security reviewer audited 100 of its decisions blind, reading the same code without seeing the verifier’s answer. On whether a finding is substantiated at all, the two broadly agree. They return the same verdict on 85% of the 73 findings both read as authorization claims, with Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.70, and per configuration that agreement is 82% on Absentia and 89% on the other (Table ). Where they part is the gap itself: the reviewer confirms Absentia at 42% and the other configuration at 43%, while the verifier separates them at 50% and 43%.

paragraphs.en: Table leaves open whether Absentia reaches only that one class of defects, so we run the same configuration unchanged in the injection suites. Figure places each tool in the ROC space, where Youden’s J is the vertical distance above the diagonal of chance. The baselines are strongest on Java and weaker on Python, and the ordering of the two panels differs: CodeQL leads on Java, 0.49 against Absentia ’s 0.37, and Absentia leads on Python, 0.43 against IRIS’s 0.24. What the panels separate them on is how far each moves between the two: 0.31 for CodeQL, 0.20 for IRIS, 0.09 for Semgrep, and 0.06 for Absentia . Every query CodeQL and Semgrep run was written before they saw the code, and how well those queries fit is a property of the language they were written for. Absentia writes nothing down in advance: it derives what to match from the repository in front of it (§ ), so a language for which it does not have queries is not a language on which it is weaker, which is why Absentia ends up working in multiple languages.

paragraphs.en: The markers also say what kind of error each tool makes, and the two model-driven baselines make the one they were built to make. paragraphs.en: Absentia sits on the other side of both panels, and its error is not flattering either. It reaches a true-positive rate of 0.85 in Python and 1.00 in Java at false-positive rates of 0.42 and 0.62. The two positions are not equivalent for whoever runs the tool. A false positive costs a reviewer the time to read the case and dismiss it, while a vulnerability nothing reports stays in the application with no later stage to recover it, which makes it the costlier of the two errors to end up on. Appendix substitutes Claude Sonnet-5 for MiniMax-2.5 on the Python suite, where the false-positive rate falls from 0.42 to 0.14 and the true-positive rate rises from 0.85 to 0.95 at 6.2 times the bill. paragraphs.en: Figure runs the re-analysis of § over all 30 instances, taking the fixed commit as the earlier analysis and the vulnerable one as the commit re-analyzed, which is the order that lets the disclosed defect be scored on the second of the two. paragraphs.zh: 该图对 § 中的所有 30 个实例进行了重新分析，将固定提交作为先前分析的对象，将存在漏洞的提交作为被重新分析的提交；这种顺序使得披露的缺陷能够在两个提交中的第二个上得到评分。 中位数提交重用了前一次运行所分析的 37% 的路径，而该曲线呈现出分裂趋势而非集中趋势：9 个实例重用了 70% 或更多的路径，从而几乎避开了全部成本；另有 8 个实例则完全没有重用任何路径，因为对某个文件的修改会使其大部分路径表失效，进而使大多数预计算的结果变得无效。

paragraphs.en: Scope of the evidence. Our instances span nine frameworks and three languages, but we acknowledge that the space of web applications is far larger than thirty of them can cover, so the recall of § may differ once Absentia is deployed in the wild. The benchmark is also silent on one stage of Absentia : no advisory in it requires two routes to be chained. paragraphs.en: Detecting vulnerabilities in web applications. Program analysis for discovering web vulnerabilities has been extensively studied, through taint tracking [ 26 ] and the query-based analyzers that run over a repository in continuous scanning [ 14 , 35 ] . These are effective where a bug can be defined once for a language, namely as a path carrying untrusted input into a dangerous operation, but they rely on expert-written source and sink specifications and on manual review of the alerts they raise. No such portable definition exists for broken access control, since what a route may expose is particular to one application. Detectors for it therefore take a notion of the intended policy from elsewhere: a specification the developer supplies [ 38 ] , consistency with the guards of comparable operations (RoleCast [ 37 ] , MACE [ 27 ] ), or a relation fixed in advance [ 17 ] , as a pattern catalog (SPACE [ 28 ] ) or as ownership read off the database schema (MOCGuard [ 24 ] ). Where the code is not read at all, authorization is instead tested by running the application and replaying one principal’s requests under another’s session [ 34 , 32 , 25 , 10 ] , at the cost of a deployment, an account for every role, and a way to drive the application into the state where each check runs.
paragraphs.zh: 检测网络应用中的漏洞。 通过污点追踪 [ 26 ] 和持续扫描仓库的基于查询的分析器 [ 14 , 35 ] ，对程序进行分析以发现网络漏洞的方法已被广泛研究。 这些方法在以下情况下有效：即一个错误可以针对某种语言一次性定义，具体表现为一条将不可信输入传递到危险操作的路径；但它们依赖于专家编写的源和汇规范，以及对所生成警报的手动审查。 对于失效的访问控制而言，并不存在类似的便携式定义，因为某个路由可能暴露的内容因应用而异。 因此，相关的检测器需要从其他来源获取预期策略的概念：例如开发者提供的规范 [ 38 ] 、与类似操作的守卫的一致性（RoleCast [ 37 ] 、MACE [ 27 ] ），或预先确定的关系 [ 17 ] ，如模式目录（SPACE [ 28 ] ）或从数据库模式中读取的所有权信息（MOCGuard [ 24 ] ）。 如果代码完全未被读取，则授权验证将通过运行应用并模拟一个主体的请求在另一个主体的会话下执行来实现 [ 34 , 32 , 25 , 10 ] ，但这种方式需要部署环境、为每个角色创建账户，以及将应用驱动到每个检查都能执行的状态。

paragraphs.en: Language models. Identifying a vulnerability was for some time beyond what a language model could do reliably, its verdicts being non-deterministic and sensitive to superficial edits such as a renamed function [ 39 , 11 ] . Frontier models are considerably stronger at it, the most recent reporting thousands of zero-days in deployed software [ 5 ] . That earlier gap motivated a line of work pairing a model with a static analysis, so that each covers what the other does poorly: for example, by having a model write the taint specifications a query needs (IRIS [ 23 ] ), by having it filter the findings a reviewer would otherwise triage (LLift [ 21 ] ), or by abstracting a repository into a code property graph so that what the model reads fits its context (LLMxCPG [ 20 ] ).
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型。 一段时间以来，识别漏洞超出了语言模型能够可靠完成的能力范围，因为其判断结果具有非确定性和对表面性修改（例如重命名函数）的敏感性 [ 39 , 11 ] 。 前沿模型在这一方面要强得多，最新的报告指出它们能够在已部署的软件中发现数千个零日漏洞 [ 5 ] 。 早期的这一差距促使了一系列研究，将模型与静态分析相结合，使两者各自弥补对方的不足：例如，让模型编写查询所需的污染规范（IRIS [ 23 ] ），让它筛选出评审员原本需要分类处理的发现结果（LLift [ 21 ] ），或者将代码库抽象为代码属性图，使模型读取的内容与其上下文相匹配（LLMxCPG [ 20 ] ）。

paragraphs.en: Agents. Given tools and left to choose what to read, a model need not be paired with an analysis at all, and agents of this kind audit a repository on demand (RepoAudit [ 15 ] , Codex Security [ 29 ] ). Exploring code and reasoning about what it means, rather than matching a pattern on it, is what allows an agent to reach a bug whose definition was never written down, and access control has begun to be approached this way [ 22 ] . Closest to Absentia is Co-RedTeam, whose discovery stage receives only the target codebase and has agents read it for candidates with supporting evidence [ 16 ] . However, it reports no implementation we can obtain or run. A parallel line establishes a vulnerability by exploiting it from the outside, an agent conducting a penetration test against a running deployment and planning its way along an attack chain [ 9 , 36 , 8 ] . Approaching an application in this way requires one to be running. Absentia reads its source instead, in the setting of § , where the engineers who own the code audit it before it is deployed.

paragraphs.en: Checking authorization in source code is a reading task, and we show that this reading can be automated: the property a route is meant to guarantee is recoverable from the application’s own code, and that code can then be held to it, so a reviewer checks a claim instead of performing the analysis. On BAC-Bench , the benchmark of 30 disclosed advisories we release, Absentia reports 19, where the static analyzers we run report none and an unstructured agent on the same model reports 3. Recovering a property is also more general than having one written in advance, so a single unchanged configuration reaches both injection, which is defined once per language, and broken access control, which is defined once per application.
paragraphs.zh: 在源代码中检查授权是一项阅读任务，我们证明了这种阅读可以自动化：一条路由旨在保证的特性可以从应用程序自身的代码中恢复出来，然后可以用该代码来验证这一特性，因此审查员只需检查一项声明，而无需亲自进行分析。 在 BAC-Bench 上，即我们发布的 30 个已披露安全建议的基准测试中，Absentia 报告了 19 个，而我们运行的静态分析器则未报告任何问题，同一模型上的一个非结构化智能体仅报告了 3 个。 恢复一项特性也比事先写好一项特性更具通用性，因此，单个未更改的配置即可同时覆盖注入问题（每种语言只需定义一次）和访问控制漏洞问题（每个应用程序只需定义一次）。

paragraphs.en: The false-positive rate Absentia records on the injection suites, 0.42 in Python and 0.62 in Java (§ ), could be a consequence of inspecting every route rather than of the model reading them.
